assertions.title: All Python tests pass
assertions.expected: `python -m pytest python/tests -q` reports at least 221 passed with no new failures; the documented cooperative-stop issue may appear as an expected xfail.
assertions.observed: `python -m pytest python/tests -q` exited 0 and reported 221 passed, 1 xfailed in 5.78s. No failures or warnings were reported in the captured output.

VAL-PY-008.reason: Pytest exited 0 with 221 passed and 1 xfailed. The xfailed case is the documented pre-existing cooperative-stop test `test_multi_account_cooperative_stop_emits_success_before_idle_sync`, so there are no new failures.

commands.result: Found `@pytest.mark.xfail(reason='Pre-existing: cooperative stop emits cancelled instead of success')` immediately above `test_multi_account_cooperative_stop_emits_success_before_idle_sync` in `python/tests/test_runner_regressions.py:274-275`.

observations: No warning lines or warnings summary appeared in the captured pytest output.
The only non-pass outcome corresponds to the documented pre-existing cooperative-stop xfail.
